remarks: Back on market with cosmetic updates and ready to go! Comfortable living can be yours in this spacious one level 2BR, 1.5BTH ranch style condo with an open layout (1100 Sq ft). All rooms are generous in size including a LR w/fireplace w/wood floor, and DR w/sliders to a private balcony. The kitchen has ample cabinet space. Updated primary BTH. The Brs also have plenty of room for your furnishings. The hot water heater, air handler for central air, dishwasher, and powder room toilet were replaced in 2023-2024. Full size w/d in unit. You have your own private large storage bin located in the semi-finished common basement area. No hassle with parking as you have a deeded GARAGE + a RESERVED outside space in the repaved lot. There are also visitor spaces for guests. The attractive and nicely landscaped complex is situated in a prime location just minutes to the train, shopping and restaurants in Glenbrook and Springdale. Downtown Stamford and Harbor Point are also just minutes away. Perfect for a 1031 tax exchange investor since easy to rent! Compare this condo to others then make this your very own home!
